intro.tts: On-chain lending only works if you're already rich. Every major market wants well over a hundred percent collateral, so a borrower with a perfect record gets the same terms as a wallet made five minutes ago. Repayment history is public. Nobody prices it. Monadic does.

model.tts: Here's the model. Your chance of default is a Bayesian estimate: a cautious prior, updated by every loan you repay on time, and by any late payment or liquidation. Your score sets three terms: collateral, from a hundred percent down to twenty-five; a risk premium, the fair price of the part you don't collateralise; and a credit limit that grows as you repay.

connect.tts: Let's try it live, with a brand-new wallet.
connect.caption: Let's try it live, with a brand-new wallet.

switch.tts: Wrong network? The app switches it for me.
switch.caption: Wrong network? The app switches it for me.

credit.tts: Everyone starts at eight hundred, and the app says why, in plain language: no history yet, no late payments, no verified wallet age. So my first loan is fully secured: a hundred-dollar limit, at just the pool rate.
credit.caption: Everyone starts at 800, and the app says why in plain language. No history yet, so my first loan is fully secured: a 100 mUSDC limit at just the pool rate.

borrow.tts: The borrow screen shows exactly what I post, what it costs, and when it's due.
borrow.caption: The borrow screen shows exactly what I post, what it costs, and when it's due.

borrowtx.tts: Approve, then borrow. Each call carries an explicit gas limit, because Monad charges the limit, not the gas used.
borrowtx.caption: Approve, then borrow. Each call carries an explicit gas limit, because Monad charges the limit, not the gas used.

loan1.tts: The loan is live. Interest accrues every second, since Monad makes a block every third of a second. On our demo clock, a second is twelve hours, so this thirty-day loan lasts one minute.
loan1.caption: Interest accrues every second: Monad makes a block every 0.3 s. On the demo clock 1 s = 12 h, so this 30-day loan lasts one minute.

loan2.tts: History is time-weighted, so borrowing and instantly repaying earns nothing. Hold a loan for three quarters of its term, and it counts in full.
loan2.caption: History is time-weighted: an instant borrow-and-repay earns nothing. Hold a loan for ¾ of its term and it counts in full.

loan3.tts: Lenders are protected twice. If I missed the due date plus three days of grace, anyone could mark me in default. My collateral pays first, then a reserve funded by risk premiums, and only then the lenders.
loan3.caption: Miss the due date plus 3 days of grace and anyone can mark a default. Collateral pays first, then the reserve funded by risk premiums, and only then lenders.

changed.tts: Same transaction, new terms. My score goes from eight hundred to eight eighty-eight, my collateral drops from a hundred to sixty-seven percent, and my limit rises to a hundred and fifty. No epochs. No off-chain jobs.
changed.caption: Same transaction, new terms: score 800 → 888, collateral 100% → 67%, limit 100 → 150. No epochs, no offchain jobs.

good.tts: A wallet with three on-time loans scores nine forty-one, and posts under half the collateral.
good.caption: Three on-time loans: 941, posting under half the collateral.

late.tts: One late payment: five seventy-one, and fully secured again. Same formula, public inputs.
late.caption: One late payment: 571, fully secured again. Same formula, public inputs.

monad.tts: Why Monad? Blocks every third of a second, so debts and scores update live. A full borrow-and-repay cycle costs about a sixth of a cent in gas, so small credit-building loans make sense. And the whole pool ships as one twenty-seven-kilobyte contract, beyond Ethereum's size limit.

next.tts: Next: wallet-age attestations, MON collateral with Pith prices, and lender tranches. Monadic: your history is your collateral.

loan4.tts: Lenders, meanwhile, earn the pool rate through a standard vault, and their share price rises every second.
loan4.caption: Lenders earn the pool rate through an ERC-4626 vault; their share price rises every second.
